Same token-weight KL fixes Shannon entropy, not ESS, gradient variance or output policy KL.
Same LoRA parameter norm does not fix effective weight/function change.
Gibbs optimality for linear fixed-eta utility is not inherited by normalized-step objective.
Prop-only positive supervision does not certify W/no-change behavior.
Three reference losses are different, not automatically orthogonal.
